notes: Closure was checked item-by-item across the whole mailbox, not just within threads. Confirmed still open: Nina's attribution appendix paragraph (no message after b20f18c2e4b60036 mentions methodology/appendix; she has mailed five times since, so the silence is selective); Wes's FY27 budget model (Sofia's Jul 13 Drive share b40f18c2e4b60035 predates Jordan's Jul 15 bump and does not close it; Wes's 'ran this through the Q4 model' in b60f18c2e4b60013 is a different artifact); Amara's photo usage rights addendum (her Aug 11 reply b10f18c2e4b60046 is about the holiday gifting rate and closes nothing — and it leaves the contract ball on Jordan, i.e. Q3); Tessa's corrected July invoice and the Aug 5 counter (no inbound from Tessa after Aug 6). Correctly excluded: the Jun 23/Jul 6 chases for Tessa's redlined SOW (b50f18c2e4b60041/42) are closed cross-thread by the Jul 30 delivery b20f18c2e4b60025 with Habitat_Goods_Q4_SOW_Redline.pdf attached, and by the fully executed DocuSign b40f18c2e4b60031; Jordan's Aug 7 request for a B-vs-C cost comparison (b60f18c2e4b60028) is closed by Sofia's Aug 10 'Looked at the numbers Tessa sent separately'; Nina's retention-experiment readout (b50f18c2e4b60012) is not yet due ('if it's not wrapping up by mid-September'). Two corpus caveats a human should weigh. (1) The Aug 12 bounce b40f18c2e4b60044 is for a message titled 'Holiday Campaign Creative — Final Round Files', not for the SOW counter or the invoice; marketing-q4-03's wording ('mailbox bounced as over quota') is accurate, but a reader could infer the counter itself bounced, which the corpus does not say. There is also an unpaired bounce b40f18c2e4b60043 (Aug 1, priyanka.rao@vaultedpr.com 'does not exist') with no matching SENT message — a phantom wait worth flagging in Q6 rather than Q4. (2) Fold & Field retainer figures are mutually inconsistent across batches ($22,000→$25,500 in b10f18c2e4b60009, $18,500 from $14,200 in b60f18c2e4b60035, $42,000 unchanged in the Jul 30 redline, $34,500 signed in the DocuSign records). The gold correctly quotes only the Aug 5 message's own terms, so no stale-fact defect — but any system that merges these threads will produce contradictory numbers. Finally, marketing-q4-04 assumes the Aug 6 Meta QBR (b40f18c2e4b60009) did not resolve the volume-rate ask; nothing in the corpus says it did, so treating it as open is right under the as-of rules, though it is the one item whose openness rests on an unrecorded meeting.
